title: V3 pre-authored development review expansion checklist
purpose: AI-authored source-only review units for the remaining 12 development cases, prepared before inspecting matched outputs. This is not an additional fixed promotion sample or an exhaustive accuracy benchmark.
activation_rule: Use when a new failure or apparent regression triggers expansion under the frozen candidate protocol, or clearly disclose a broader all-case review. Do not silently pool these units into the fixed eight-case gate or alter that gate. Record activated case IDs and the reason for each.

provenance.construction_inputs: The remaining development cases' source_text and expectations, plus the fixed checklist method. No saved model outputs, training examples, or reserved notes were read during this construction.
provenance.quote_validation: Every exact quotation was programmatically found in an original source segment belonging to the same event label. Repeated headings join one event; unlabeled notes use event_label null.

method.unit: One stable claim_id is one review unit. Some units bundle a related chronology or attribution distinction. Count the unit once only when its stated factual requirements and critical meaning distinctions are preserved; do not award separate points for its clauses or repeated renderings.
method.placed_supported: Allow faithful paraphrases. The unit must appear in the correct event and an acceptable factual field with required speaker, time, status, scope and references. A date/time zone stated once for that event may provide shared context. A temporal history may retain an earlier state only if clearly superseded by the supplied correction/update.
method.distinction_rules: Critical meaning distinctions constrain what the output may assert; they do not require repeating every source denial when a concise claim preserves the meaning. Explicit uncertainty or correction included in factual_claim is part of the required unit. Do not infer a missing claim from a mere reference or quote match.
method.not_placed: Source quotations, evidence tables, unassigned excerpts, questions, or suggestions alone do not count as correctly placed factual claims. A partial unit is recorded as partial, without fractional credit. An empty/failed group is not a correct result.
method.field_rules: All units currently name one intended/acceptable field. If future checklist revisions permit alternatives, they must state a source-based rationale before outputs are reviewed. Do not broaden acceptable fields retrospectively to raise a result.
method.critical_errors: Review the entire returned draft and suggestions, including text outside this checklist. Independently record invented facts/approvals, actor or time changes, reversed negation, unsupported impact certainty, stale corrected status, false completion, and material cross-event attribution. Matching quotes or checklist fragments does not establish support.

categories.correct_meaning: Correct one distinct factual claim's attribution, time, negation, status, scope, or reference; include unsupported factual assertions inside suggestions.
categories.remove_unsupported_claim: Remove one unsupported claim that cannot be repaired into a supported statement; includes claims outside the checklist.
categories.place_missing_unit: Insert or reconstruct one checklist unit from source/evidence/unassigned material into its correct event/field, including failed groups.
categories.move_supported_unit: Move one already supported unit from the wrong event/field into the correct location.
categories.remove_unnecessary_advice: Remove one redundant, contradictory, or unjustified suggestion/question, treating a suggestion and its matching confirmation question as one unit.
categories.remove_duplicate: Remove a materially redundant repeated claim or excerpt requiring substantive cleanup; ignore cosmetic formatting.

substantive_edit_proxy.counting: Record each needed repair with linked claim_ids and categories, then count unique substantive repair operations. One operation may fix several linked units: count it once, not once per linked ID or category. Distinct repairs remain separate. Use correct_meaning before relocation when the same statement requires both; annotate relocation without double-counting. Record restoration of a failed group by the missing review units that must be reconstructed, not zero work.
substantive_edit_proxy.limits: This is an AI-assisted editing-burden proxy, not elapsed review time, user preference, or measured productivity. Store rationale so a human can challenge repair grouping; apply the same grouping rule to every variant.

method.reporting: Report placed units, missing/partial units, critical errors, failures, and edit operations per case and domain. Raw pooled counts are descriptive; do not let longer cases or repeated clauses conceal a domain regression. Use the frozen promotion protocol, not a new composite score or an accuracy percentage.
method.scope_limits: Omitted source details can still be important and must be recorded separately. This small deliberate sample does not cover every logging task. Assistance-off cases should not generate proposed impacts/actions/plans; ordinary clarification questions are assessed for relevance under the same runtime contract.
method.failure_expansion: The protocol also requires review of new failures/regressions outside these eight cases. Their review needs a separately identified source-only checklist prepared without tuning this fixed checklist to improve scores. Preserve this file's hash and disclose the expansion.

claims.factual_claim: At 13:00Z on 12 September 2026, the draft count of sixteen was corrected to the returned cover sheet's six; this was not a new inspection.

critical_meaning_distinctions: Preserve the source of the count; do not treat sixteen as current or certify an independently observed inspection.
